description: Three locators that do not resolve, and the two different facts that covers. note-ranking#7 parses and names a section the note no longer has; note-absent#0 parses and names a note this generation does not hold. Both are locator_expired (-32003): the source changed incompatibly, and returning a neighbouring section would be the different revision the protocol forbids substituting. The third has no section segment and so is not a notes locator at all: locator_unknown (-32002), which is a statement about the reference rather than about the source.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
